page: Amazon Web Services c8in.32xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. The instance is built on x86_64 Intel processor architecture capable of clock speeds up to 3.9 GHz. It features 128 dedicated virtual CPUs across 64 physical cores using two threads per core. System memory is provisioned at 256 GB, resulting in a compute-focused ratio of 2.0 GB per core without discrete GPU hardware acceleration.

Storage configuration on the c8in.32xlarge provides no bundled local NVMe storage, requiring all persistent file systems to depend entirely on attached network block volumes. To facilitate substantial data throughput and inter-node coordination, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 200 Gbps, providing low network latency and high throughput for multi-node deployments.

From an architectural efficiency perspective, the hardware profile eliminates costs tied to unneeded local drive capacity or disproportionately large memory pools, focusing resource density directly on CPU power and high-speed networking. The primary operational tradeoff involves handling storage I/O across the network rather than through direct-attached SSDs. Consequently, the c8in.32xlarge fits parallel batch compute, clustered simulation tasks, distributed stream processing, and network virtual appliances.
description: Amazon Web Services c8in.32xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. Featuring an x86_64 Intel processor running at up to 3.9 GHz, the server delivers 128 dedicated vCPUs across 64 physical cores with two threads per core. System memory is sized at 256 GB, providing 2.0 GB per vCPU to balance dense parallel computation with low memory footprint overheads. The instance includes no bundled local NVMe storage, relying completely on external network storage, and operates without GPU acceleration. A defining characteristic is its baseline network throughput of 200 Gbps, enabling rapid data ingest, node synchronization, and distributed processing. The c8in.32xlarge is designed for high-performance computing, distributed network appliances, scalable compute clusters, and intensive data processing tasks where compute density and massive network bandwidth are prioritized over integrated local disks.
